title.value: When Do Transformers Shine in RL? Decoupling Memory from Credit Assignment
title.justification: This is the title of the paper.
title.quote: When Do Transformers Shine in RL? Decoupling Memory from Credit Assignment

extractions.description: This paper investigates the underlying reasons for the strong performance of Transformer-based methods in Reinforcement Learning (RL). It introduces formal definitions of memory length and credit assignment length, and designs simple configurable tasks to measure these distinct quantities. The empirical results reveal that Transformers can enhance the memory capability of RL algorithms, but do not improve long-term credit assignment.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper is focused on improving RL algorithms, and does not directly address Sustainable Development.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms face two distinct challenges: learning effective representations of past and present observations, and determining how actions influence future returns.
